about: CodeQL results reviewed and found not to be vulnerabilities, by rule and file. The Security workflow fails on any result not listed here. A new result in a listed file under a listed rule still passes, so keep each entry's reason specific and re-review the file when it changes materially.

reviewed.reason: SHA-256 of a module's source, used as a content token to detect a concurrent edit. No password is involved.
SHA-256 of the module listing, used to notice that a project changed on disk. No password is involved.
encodeXml escapes the five characters XML gives meaning; a backslash has none in XML.
Tags are stripped to produce a shape caption as plain text, and written back into VML the file keeps. No webview inserts HTML: every innerHTML use only clears a node, and captions are set as text.
Tests whether the metadata part already declares the dynamic-array XML namespace. Nothing is fetched or trusted by URL.
Every webview page sets the CSP default-src 'none' with nonce-only scripts, so no frame can exist inside it. The only window that can post to it is VS Code's own webview host.
